tree.heading: Third-party providers
tree.text: The Secretaries may enter into an agreement with a third party to carry out any provision of this chapter.

tree.heading: US Geological Survey
tree.text: The Secretaries shall work with the Director of the United States Geological Survey to collect, aggregate, digitize, standardize, or publish data on behalf of the Secretaries to meet the requirements of this chapter.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2025—Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 118–234 substituted “shall” for “may” and “the Secretaries” for “the Secretary of the Interior”.
